flat-banker.title: Flat Banker
flat-banker.summary: One unit on Banker, every hand. The lowest-edge way to play.
rules: Bet **1 unit on Banker** every hand, win or lose.
Ties push and change nothing.

flat-player.title: Flat Player
flat-player.summary: One unit on Player, every hand.
rules: Bet **1 unit on Player** every hand, win or lose.
Ties push and change nothing.

flat-tie.title: Flat Tie
flat-tie.summary: One unit on Tie, every hand. Shown for comparison: by far the dearest of the three.
rules: Bet **1 unit on Tie** every hand, win or lose.

martingale.title: Martingale
martingale.summary: Double after every loss, so one win gets everything back. Until a long losing run doesn't.
rules: Start at **1 unit**. After a **loss**, double the bet: 1, 2, 4, … 64 units.
After a **win**, go back to 1 unit. A tie repeats the same bet.
After **7 losses in a row** (or when the next bet is over the table limit), give up the chase and go back to 1 unit.
On Banker, a win after a long run of losses can still lose money overall, because the commission grows with the bet.

paroli.title: Paroli
paroli.summary: Let a win ride up to three times, then start again.
rules: Start at **1 unit**. After a **win**, double: 1, 2, 4 units.
After the **third win in a row**, or after any **loss**, go back to 1 unit. A tie repeats the same bet.

one-three-two-six.summary: Four steps on a winning run: 1, 3, 2 and 6 units.
rules: Bet **1, 3, 2, 6 units**, moving one step on after each **win**.
After the **fourth win**, or after any **loss**, go back to 1 unit. A tie repeats the same bet.

fibonacci.title: Fibonacci
fibonacci.summary: A gentler loss-chaser that walks up the Fibonacci numbers.
rules: A **loss** moves one step forward. A **win** moves two steps back, never below the first step. A tie repeats the same bet.
A loss on 89 units goes back to the first step.

dalembert.title: D'Alembert
dalembert.summary: Add a unit after a loss, take one off after a win.
rules: Start at **1 unit**. After a **loss**, bet 1 unit more. After a **win**, bet 1 unit less, never below 1.
The bet never goes over **20 units**: at the cap it stays there until a win. A tie repeats the same bet.

labouchere.title: Labouchère
labouchere.summary: Cross numbers off a line: each win removes two, each loss adds one.
rules: Write the line **1-2-3-4**. Bet the **first plus the last** number (with one number left, bet it).
A **win** crosses both numbers off. A **loss** adds the amount you bet to the end of the line. A tie repeats the same bet.
When the line is empty, write 1-2-3-4 again.
A bet over **100 units** restarts the line, so the next bet is 5 units.

follow-the-shoe.title: Follow the shoe
follow-the-shoe.summary: Bet on whichever side won the last decided hand.
rules: Bet **1 unit on the side that won the last hand that wasn't a tie**. Ties are skipped.
On the first hand of a shoe, bet Banker.

side-bet-sprinkler.title: Side-bet sprinkler
side-bet-sprinkler.summary: A flat Banker bet with small side bets on every hand.
rules: Bet **1 unit on Banker** every hand.
Add the same small **side bets** every hand as well (by default $5 on Player Pair and $5 on Banker Pair).
